title: KCP artifact_upload_finalize request (DESIGN.md §10.10, §11.6.1 space/content mutation family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Commits uploading -> sealing (§10.10 spelled): the artifact service then seals an immutable object version, prevents further writes, and verifies the trusted bytes against the declared facts and the exact scanner/policy versions. Verification observations are never wire arguments (gap note KG29). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal; mapped connector (only for contribution/reaction/upload operations granted to it) (assurance: current login (principal); workload identity (mapped connector)). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

args.description: Exact target by record id (§10.10 field name); the transition is the op itself (gap note KG29).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
